description: Land Acquisition - Hirikete , Ridigama D/S/D, Kurunegala District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific plot of land (Lot A in Hiriketehenyaya) for a public purpose. The core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category for land and property-related matters. Although it is issued by a named Minister, the content does not describe his appointment, portfolio responsibilities, or any government restructuring; it is a procedural notice regarding a land transaction. Therefore, the specialized Type 4 classification takes precedence.
